Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

The requested public PreparedStudy.estimate(key,estimate) is not present: PreparedStudy exposes run/work/count/preview but only a private occupancy helper, and StudyPlan.estimateTrial remains private[plan]. The runner uses that private pipeline for frame/window/initial policy/occupancy/density. RealStudyBackend.trialPreview still refuses supported revisions, so the principal consumer need remains.

Evidence:
- plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/StudyWork.scala:35
- plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/StudyWork.scala:223
- plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/StudyPlan.scala:1084
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/real/RealStudyBackend.scala:596

Remaining / next action: Expose a typed single-trial estimate using the exact existing runner pipeline; handle unknown key, geometry and policy failures with key-bearing values, test equivalence to runner densities on both runtimes, replace fake/real preview reassembly and re-record the API audit.

Disposition: Keep open.
